jobs.title: Creative Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
We're TeeTurtle, a consumer products company that creates nerdy toys, games, apparel, and accessories. We are passionate about creating products that allow our fans to express themselves and share meaningful experiences. Inclusivity is at the heart of what we do—we strive to create a welcoming space for all fans and team members, celebrating diverse perspectives and voices. We’re excited to continue expanding our team and fostering a culture where everyone can thrive!


 

    Position Description


 The goal of the Creative Operations Specialist is to coordinate and track the creation of innovative, stylized products and processes from product concept to completion, aligned with the organization’s vision. In addition to the accountabilities listed below, other projects and duties may be assigned.


 


  Primary Accountabilities


 
   Product Development
   
    Set up and organize all product development queues (in Trello or other software) at an expert level to ensure processes are executed within expected timelines, and each project is completed on schedule
    Track and communicate on the progress for all products from concept through approved prototype, communicating any roadblocks or issues to appropriate team members to meet brand standards and deliver high-quality products in an efficient manner
    Ensure that all prototyping documentation such as the Line Plan Release Calendar, Rolling 20 Prototyping Queue, Product Approval Slide Decks, and other ongoing product tracking guides/tools are maintained through regular updates and audits to keep all releases on track
    Assist the Creative Operations Manager with project and process management across all brands and ensure that all deliverables for ongoing projects are tracked and project-related processes are updated
   
   Collaboration
   
    Collaborate with the supply chain, marketing, sales, and all creative teams on assigned projects and processes to prevent/overcome roadblocks and communicate information efficiently
    Document, audit, and update SOPs as assigned for various processes both within the Creative Operations team and for the Creative Department as a whole to ensure clear and consistent documentation is available and up-to-date
    Assist in creating and presenting training materials and product guidelines to ensure other members of the team have access to the most up-to-date process information, documentation, and tracking tools/sheets
    Collaborate with the Creative Operations Manager to execute new projects that support the company’s creative vision and growth goals by identifying actionable steps to allow successful implementation
   
   Organization
   
    Maintain all technical and procedural art/product file folders, ensuring files are organized, updated, and available to internal teams without confusion about which versions of files are to be utilized
    Suggest and implement process improvements to continually increase creative output and minimize errors and frustration among internal partners
    Assist the Creative Operations Manager in the development of new tools for progress tracking, documentation, and communication archives and ensure that they are properly utilized by informing the team of changes in process and coaching them on usage
    Update assignment tracking tools with new project deliverables and deadlines as they arise to ensure all information is available for scheduling purposes and projects stay on track
    Assist with ad-hoc organizational projects and tasks such as drive audits, verifying documentation storage, etc., and one-off projects to keep the team informed and operating efficiently
   
 
 

    Skills & Competencies


 
  

     Collaboration: Works collaboratively with team members to achieve departmental goals; ensures alignment before undertaking work
   Communication: Provides information clearly and concisely; checks for understanding; listens actively; adapts communication style to audience; communicates effectively across required channels
   Execution: Is attentive to details; completes tasks on time and with minimal mistakes; identifies roadblocks and risks that may impact successful accomplishment of accountabilities
   Optimization: Identifies redundancies, unnecessary or outdated processes in domains of accountability and makes recommendations for optimization
   Priority and Task Management: Develops logical and systemic processes to achieve goals and deliverables; prioritizes and sequences tasks to achieve goals and deliverables; tracks progress on tasks and assesses priorities when needed; completes tasks on time and initiates required handoffs
   Problem-Solving: Identifies problems effectively; troubleshoots tasks; knows who and when to ask for help; identifies appropriate solutions that offer long-term resolutions
   Project Management: Plans and executes projects within their domain
 
  Qualifications


 
  Bachelor’s degree or minimum 2 years of equivalent experience (required)
  1–3 years of experience supporting project coordination, project administration, or operational workflows (required)
  Experience coordinating and updating multiple projects simultaneously while balancing competing priorities and meeting deadlines (preferred)
  Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate documentation across multiple concurrent projects (required)
  Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment (preferred)
  Experience supporting product development, creative operations, merchandising, or similar workflows (preferred)
  Proficiency in Google Suite (preferred)
  Proficiency with Trello or similar project management software (required)
  Ability to remain flexible and adapt quickly to changing priorities and deadlines (required)
 
 
  Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
  Ability to travel (est. 1-2 times per year)
  U.S. residency
 
 


 

    Compensation and Benefits


 The salary range for this position is $60,000 - $70,000 + up to 10% bonus eligibility.


 


 

    We also offer


 

 
  Medical, dental, and vision coverage through our ICHRA program, with monthly company contributions toward coverage
  20+ days of PTO annually, increasing by 1 day for each year of service, plus paid holidays
  401(k) with a company match
  75% employee discount and free shipping on TeeTurtle.com and UnstableGames.com
  Flexible, remote-first work environment that supports work-life balance
  A creative and fast-paced work environment
  A culture of integrity, compassion, curiosity, and calmness
 
 

    The Hiring Process

   We require you to submit the following to consider your application:


 

 
  Resume
  Answers to all required application questions
 
 


  Please submit your application promptly, as we will close the role and no longer accept applications once we have received a sufficient number of strong candidates.


 


 If selected to move forward after an initial application review, candidates can expect the following stages:


 
   Stage 1: Participate in a video screening via Google Meet
   Stage 2: Participate in a final interview with a panel via Google Meet
 
 


 Submit your application as soon as possible, as the role will close once we receive enough strong candidates. We will reach out to candidates via email, please check your email settings to ensure that emails from teeturtle.recruitee.com will not be forwarded to your spam folder.

TeeTurtle complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. If we can offer reasonable accommodations to you in the application or interview processes, or if you have feedback on how we could improve the equity or accessibility of our recruitment, you are welcome to contact us at careers@teeturtle.com with the subject line “Accommodation Request - Name of Position”. jobs.title: Creative Operations & Production Trainee, Game Show Group
jobs.description:
About the position

Our Emerging Talent Programs, which include Interns and Trainees, offer unique opportunities for students, recent graduates, and emerging talent to work alongside the teams that come together to create movies, TV shows, and other great experiences. These seasonal, paid assignments provide meaningful and productive work that allows you to build on your experience and develop your skills further. You will be provided with challenging tasks, real-world experience, and many educational and social networking opportunities. This Summer/Fall 2026 Trainee position is from June 2026 to December 4, 2026 (start and end dates are flexible based on your schedule), and all candidates must be able to work 40 hours a week, Monday through Friday in the specified location. This type of opportunity will jump-start your career and prepare you for a career in the desired field. This is not a remote role. A hybrid work option may or may not be available. We work for the Brand Creative & Digital Marketing Team, as part of Sony Pictures Television. Our team is part of the Game Show Group, and we work across several different lanes/workflows - Wheel of Fortune, Jeopardy!, Raid the Cage, and any other property currently in development. We support internal stakeholders (producers, content managers, creatives, executives) and external partners, as well as the consumer products, mobile games, licensing, and development teams. Our team works on campaigns and projects for our various workflows and deliverables, including events, newsletters, sizzle & sales reels, print ads, on-air promos, digital and social campaigns, show graphics packages, logos, pitch decks, and other custom graphics. Our remit covers the full production lifecycle for content creation, video and graphics in the marketing/branding space, from pre-production and planning through kickoff, execution and post-mortem.

Responsibilities

Work closely with the Manager and Senior Manager to support creative operations/production duties in Airtable and our DAM, such as resource/traffic management, scoping & forecasting, out-of-office tracking, reviewing creative briefs, intake and activation of new creative requests and asset managementDistill real-time information and take live notes during meetings – reviews, briefings, kickoff – and help identify/execute any action items. This also includes preparing weekly meeting agenda for live syncs with creative and production team members, and/or helping to prepare a written weekly team-wide status reportBuild, test, launch, and troubleshoot grid, Gantt, Kanban, and calendar views along with other interfaces and reporting dashboards for different teams within our division. Help with active Airtable maintenance and evolution - solidifying information hierarchies, building and testing formulas and automations, customizing interfaces and dashboards, researching new product releases and proposing use cases to support team growthSupport Senior Manager with staffing and onboarding/offboarding, which includes scheduling interviews, updating candidate tracker, prepping internal stakeholders for interview panels, sending templated emails to new hires, adding/removing system access, and working with internal teams on equipment needsCentralize all production calendars (tape days, air dates, etc.) within Airtable while also helping to audit, log, organize and add new documentation to our branded assets tracker and library of brand HQsRequirements

Background in television or entertainment is a plusExcellent verbal and written communication skillsSelf-motivated, quick on their feet with ability to pivot; creative problem solverManages time appropriately and meets aggressive deadlinesBenefits

jobs.title: Project Manager, Creative Services
jobs.description:
Remote US & Canada

Role Overview:

Team: Marketing Operations

Reports To: Director of Marketing Operations

We are seeking a Project Manager, Creative Services, to lead and support our multidisciplinary creative teams. In this role, you will oversee the planning, prioritization, and delivery of artistic assets, while supporting the Head of Creative. You’ll play a pivotal role in optimizing creative workflows, aligning resources with priorities, and fostering a collaborative environment where artists, designers, and producers can thrive. At this time the role reports to the Director of Marketing Operations but that may change in the future.

As the central coordinator for creative requests and projects, you’ll ensure smooth communication across departments, balance workloads, and remove roadblocks so the team can stay focused and inspired. By combining hands-on project management with people leadership, you will empower our creatives to do their best work, crafting emotionally impactful experiences that connect players around the world.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Project Management



Coordinate the intake, prioritization, and scheduling of creative asset requests across teams (Marketing, Community, Art, etc.). Manage timelines, deliverables, and expectations for both in-game and external creative content. Facilitate reviews, approvals, and feedback loops between stakeholders and creative leads. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Act as the bridge between creative, production, marketing, publishing, and external partners. Collaborate with leadership to align creative output with overall studio goals and project roadmaps. Ensure timely delivery of assets to support game updates, social campaigns, community events, and product launches. Support and produce the annual Sky Creator Award Show in partnership with the community and creative team

Workflow & Process Optimization

Develop and refine creative processes, pipelines, and tools to support a flexible and iterative creative environment. Help maintain documentation, brief templates, style guides, and asset management systems. Drive improvements in creative workflows, removing blockers and increasing visibility for all stakeholders. 

Resource Coordination

Track resourcing needs and help balance workload across internal creatives and external collaborators (freelancers, vendors, agencies). Facilitate onboarding and coordination of external creative partners where needed. Protect creative team bandwidth by streamlining communications and minimizing unnecessary disruptions. Can pitch in to support with creative assets. 

Qualifications

4–6+ years experience in creative operations, project/production management, or related roles—preferably within games, animation, interactive media, or entertainment. Deep understanding of creative workflows across disciplines like concept art, design, narrative, and marketing. Familiarity with project management tools (e.g. Notion, Jira, Airtable, Trello) and creative software (e.g. Adobe Creative Suite, Figma). Highly organized, detail-oriented, and excellent at multitasking across projects with different timelines. Empathetic communicator who can support and advocate for creative teams while managing expectations across the studio. Passion for emotionally resonant games and thatgamecompany’s mission of creating positive, human-centered experiences. 

Nice to Have

Experience working with international teams and remote creative collaborators. Background in asset management or digital content libraries. Familiarity with live service or ongoing game development pipelines. Has video or image editing experience. 

Perks:

Paid Time Off, Holidays and Two Weeks Winter BreakEmployees and their dependents get medical, dental, and vision coverage, regardless of their level, tenure, or position within the company. Moreover, these benefits start on the first day of the job—there’s no waiting period before they kick in. Pet Insurance for those who need it too. Compassionate leave for employees who needs to take care of their family membersPre-tax wellness stipendPre-tax work from home stipendAccess our savings plan (401K program) with company matchMental health resources including Headspace membership and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Discount portal for everyday goods and servicesEmployee inclusive and diversity initiatives such as Grow TogetherSupport for personal professional development

We look forward to meeting you!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

The salary range for this position is $71,000 USD to $124,000 USD annually, with the

opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the Company’s compensation practices. Employees in this position are eligible to participate in the Company’s standard employee benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, vision, 401k, and paid time off.

Our base pay is benchmarked against regional market and industry data and is adjusted to reflect the cost of living in your specific geographic area.

 about this team

 core responsibilities

 qualifications

jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Head of Global Creative and Product Development Operations – Licensed Merchandise

San Mateo, CA (Collab)/Remote 

Job DescriptionWe are looking for an experienced Head of Global Creative and Product Development Operations on the Licensed Merchandise Team with strong global operations, creative, and licensing experience to manage the global creative and product development team.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for processes, deadlines, consumer trends, and the ability to drive creative excellence across various projects.

You have a proven track record for working on large IP projects and culturally relevant programs with partners across hardlines and softlines categories to grow the PlayStation brand and our software IP titles.

This role will oversee the creative and product development processes and teams, as well as coordinate all milestones to successfully go to market across the entire Licensed Merchandise Team.

You will partner closely with the Licensing leads, licensees and gaming studios, franchise, retail marketing and other cross-functional teams, to bring the global vision, strategy, and operational plan to life.

This role will work with executives and stakeholders, internally and externally, to deliver business results. We are seeking an out-of-the-box thinker, who can operate proactively in a fast-paced environment and is able to wear many hats.

Responsibilities:Team management and experience coaching

Detailed understanding of the product development processes, production, and manufacturing, timelines

Lead full concept to production lifecycle for creative assets , ensuring teams deliver on time, on budget and at scale

Design and implement streamlined workflows to improve speed, consistency and quality

Lead the planning and development of style guides, creative assets, PD tools, and serving as the primary driver behind the creation process

Collaborate with external agencies to source talent and manage the execution of creative projects, ensuring alignment with brand standards and objectives

Guide creative collaboration throughout the project lifecycle

Lead all stages of product development across all categories for any licensing deal or collaborations

Undertake general design tasks to support Licensing team’s efforts, including but not limited to branding, packaging, promotional and marketing collateral trade show needs, and sales materials

Skills and Qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Design, Marketing, or a related field

Proven experience (15-20 years) in a creative leadership role, within the licensing and consumer products industry

Proficiency in project management tools

Strong project management abilities, including the capacity to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage resources effectively

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and influence stakeholders at all levels

A strategic mindset with a deep understanding of market trends, consumer behavior, and brand positioning

Gaming or Entertainment experience preferred

Proven experience to manage studios (film, series or game) in the creation of product development

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Creative Services & Creative Operations
jobs.description:
About the position

At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals! As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People. At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights. Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today! Your Role: Senior Manager, Creative Services & Creative Operations As the Senior Manager of Creative Services & Creative Operations, you will be a pivotal leader responsible for building, leading, and scaling a modern in-house creative agency organization. In this role, you will partner with the US Pet Health and Farm Animal Marketing teams to deliver high-quality, high-velocity creative content production across all channels. You will serve as both a creative authority and a systems architect, blending creative direction with operational excellence to transform how Elanco’s marketing content is planned, produced, and delivered, and build a future-ready team that effectively integrates AI-enabled tools into everyday creative production while operating within a regulated environment.

Responsibilities

Creative Leadership & Content Strategy Establish and evolve the creative vision, standards, and content frameworks across US Pet Health digital initiatives. Ensure consistent brand expression, storytelling quality, and customer experience across channels. Act as a senior creative authority, reviewing and guiding high-impact work and resolving creative challenges. Partner with brand and marketing leaders to align creative output with business objectives and demand generation strategies.Content Factory & Workflow Design Design and optimize scalable, end-to-end content production workflows (from intake and ideation through production, versioning, review, and distribution). Transition the organization from campaign-based execution to always-on, modular content production. Implement systems that enable content reuse, personalization, and lifecycle marketing. Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve speed-to-market, throughput, and quality.Technology, AI & Creative Operations Leadership Own the creative and content operations technology roadmap, including DAM, CMS, workflow automation, and collaboration tools. Identify, pilot, and scale AI-enabled creative workflows (e.g., ideation, copy generation, design assistance, localization, versioning, QA). Establish governance, best practices, and guardrails for responsible AI use in partnership with legal, compliance, and IT teams. Evaluate new tools and vendors, build business cases, and lead adoption across the creative organization.Team Leadership & Capability Development Lead and grow a multidisciplinary in-house team including writers, designers, content strategists, and creative operations specialists. Define future-state skill sets and hiring profiles aligned with AI-enabled and system-driven creative production. Champion upskilling, training, and change management to help the team adopt new tools and ways of working. Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance creative culture.Stakeholder Partnership & Business Impact Drive adoption of in-house agency services by clearly articulating value, capabilities, and service models. Build trusted partnerships with marketing, brand, lifecycle, and channel teams to understand needs and prioritize work. Manage demand intake, capacity planning, and prioritization across the organization. Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, cost effectiveness, speed, and creative quality.Quality, Governance & Delivery Ensure all creative output meets brand standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality benchmarks. Oversee quality assurance throughout the creative process and hold final accountability for delivered work. Establish and track KPIs related to delivery, quality, efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction. Utilize project and workflow management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) to ensure transparency and accountability.Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.Experience: 5+ years of experience in creative, content, or digital marketing roles, with proven leadership of in-house agencies, content studios, or creative operations teams.Strong understanding of digital content creation, web development processes, and lifecycle marketing.Top Skills: Creative direction and brand stewardship across digital channels, with experience designing and scaling content production workflows and operating models with agility and speed.A tech-first approach with demonstrated ability to integrate new technologies—including AI—into creative or marketing workflows, backed by experience with marketing and creative operations technologies (e.g., DAM, CMS, MRM, workflow tools).An entrepreneurial mindset with strong stakeholder management, leadership capabilities, and excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts.Nice-to-haves

Experience working in regulated industries (healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences).Hands-on experience piloting or scaling generative AI tools for creative or content production.Background in content strategy, modular content systems, or personalization at scale.Experience driving operational efficiency while improving creative quality.Benefits

Multiple relocation packagesTwo weeklong shutdowns (mid-summer and year-end) in the US (in addition to PTO)8-week parental leave9 Employee Resource GroupsAnnual bonus offeringFlexible work arrangementsUp to 6% 401K matching
